_comment: Development / SIPp-rig credential fixture for SIPD_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE=file.
Production resolves credentials over NATS request-reply against apps/api; see
internal/credentials/nats.go for the intended rpc.sip.v1.credential contract.
`realm` is the document-level default; an account may override it. Each account may carry
either `password` (converted to HA1 at load and then discarded) or a precomputed `ha1` =
orgId is the tenant that owns the AOR — it is what lands in the registrations KV key and in
every sip.reg.v1 event, so it must be a real organization UUID.
